ABOUT THE COLLECTION

A starting point for careful reading.

This library combines the supplied arXiv AI safety and security collection with foundational reward-hacking papers discussed in the literature review and new arXiv submissions discovered by the updater. It includes attacks, defenses, evaluations, and conceptual work—not just demonstrated attacks.

Broad topic labels come from automated screening. New arrivals are marked Auto-screened; inclusion is not an assessment of their quality or attack success. Reward-hacking annotations distinguish abstract-level screening from full-text evidence. A black-box label for a target model does not automatically imply black-box access to its reward function; inspect the paper’s methods before relying on that classification.

arXiv update status

Only new submissions matching the configured AI safety and security topics are considered. Citation counts may take time to appear. This index is not endorsed by arXiv.
